job.name: GitLab Agent
job.description: Process assigned GitLab work using the GitLab Agent skill.

payload.message: Read skill `gitlab-agent` and run. Use the full one-hour work window while actionable work remains. If an item is waiting on CI, review, or a maintainer, move to the next item. Before ending early, refresh the whole queue and relevant CI, and state in the run summary why no remaining item can be advanced.
